text: DLUHC AFFORDABLE HOUSING AI DEEP-DIVE PACK DEFONEOS DLUHC AFFORDABLE HOUSING AI DEEP-DIVE PACK 12 DLUHC Affordable Housing entry points · 8 transformation priorities · 6 DEFONEOS MCPs · DLUHC/Homes England/LGA/OHB backbone 12 Entry Points 8 Priorities 6 MCPs 4 Backbone Orgs WHY AFFORDABLE HOUSING GETS A DEDICATED PACK The Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities (DLUHC) leads the government’s efforts to increase the supply of affordable housing, regenerate communities, and tackle homelessness. The housing crisis in the UK is a complex, multi-faceted challenge, with a significant shortfall in affordable homes impacting economic growth, social mobility, and individual well-being. Legislative frameworks such as the Affordable Homes Programme and planning reforms aim to address these issues, but their effectiveness relies on accurate data, efficient resource allocation, and robust monitoring. The vast array of local authority housing strategies, private developer contributions, and diverse funding streams necessitates intelligent systems for effective oversight. DEFONEOS offers a sovereign-by-design solution to DLUHC for accelerating affordable housing delivery. It provides advanced analytics for identifying optimal development sites, forecasting housing needs, and streamlining planning processes. By integrating data from local authorities, Homes England, and other key stakeholders, DEFONEOS enables more efficient allocation of funding and proactive intervention in areas facing critical housing shortages.
